<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

  <rect x="0" y="112" width="390" height="650" fill="url(#chatPattern)"/>

    <rect x="146" y="124" width="98" height="28" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="142" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#959394">TODAY</text>

  <!-- incoming bubble 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="164" width="245" height="62" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="16,174 9,181 16,190" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <text x="29" y="210" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#959394">9:42 AM</text>

  <!-- outgoing bubble 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="119" y="240" width="255" height="66" rx="8" fill="#D9FDD3"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="374,249 381,256 374,265" fill="#D9FDD3"/>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="320" width="275" height="88" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="16,330 9,337 16,346" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="29" y="343" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">That sounds like him 🐶</text>
  <text x="29" y="367" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Did he enjoy the new park?</text>
  <text x="29" y="392" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#959394">9:45 AM</text>

  <!-- outgoing bubble 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="99" y="427" width="275" height="88" rx="8" fill="#D9FDD3"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="374,437 381,444 374,453" fill="#D9FDD3"/>
  <text x="112" y="450" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">He chased every tennis ball.</text>
  <text x="112" y="474" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Now he's asleep by the sofa 😴</text>
  <text x="112" y="499" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5B7660">9:47 AM</text>
  <polyline points="327,494 331,498 337,491" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="333,494 337,498 343,491" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="108" y="503" width="42" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <text x="129" y="521" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#000000">❤️ 2</text>

  <!-- incoming bubble 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="543" width="260" height="66" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <polygon points="16,553 9,560 16,569" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="29" y="566" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Classic Archie! Send me a photo?</text>
  <text x="29" y="590" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#959394">9:49 AM</text>

  <!-- outgoing bubble 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="158" y="630" width="216" height="65" rx="8" fill="#D9FDD3"/>
  </g>
  <polygon points="374,640 381,647 374,656" fill="#D9FDD3"/>
  <text x="171" y="653" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000000">Absolutely. One sleepy pup!</text>
  <text x="171" y="678" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5B7660">9:50 AM</text>
  <polyline points="328,673 332,677 338,670" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="334,673 338,677 344,670" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- composing input -->
  <rect x="0" y="762" width="390" height="60" fill="#F5F2EBCC"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="791" r="14" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
